name: Baby Mumpot Waterbottle Smile Baby Drinking Water Pot With Straw & Pipe 300Ml Multicolor Available
description:
Description:
Keep your little one hydrated in style with the Baby Mumpot Water Bottle. Designed with a fun smiley pattern and a built-in straw and pipe, this 300ml water pot is perfect for babies aged 8 months and above. Made from high-quality, BPA-free materials, it’s safe, durable, and easy to use. Its lightweight, multicolor design makes it both attractive and practical for daily use.

Product Type: Water pot with pipe

Capacity: 300ml

Material Safety: BPA-free

Age Recommendation: 8 months+

Color: Multicolor (available in assorted designs)

Features:

High-quality and durable

Easy to use and clean

Fun and colorful design for kids

Country of Origin: China
